title: The Second Flat
setting: 11am. Indiranagar, 3rd Cross. A two-storey house with a mango tree in the compound. Krishnamurthy uncle is sitting on a plastic chair with the front-page Vijaya Karnataka folded on his lap. He stands up slowly.

beats.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸಾರ್. ಬನ್ನಿ. ನೀವು engineer ಅಂದ್ರೆ?
beats.translit: namaskāra sār. banni. nīvu engineer andre?
beats.en: Hello, sir. Come. You're the engineer?
beats.beat: folds the paper, takes his time

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಸಾರ್. ಹೌದು, ನಾನು engineer. Indiranagar ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ flat ಬೇಕು.
choices.translit: namaskāra sār. haudu, nānu engineer. Indiranagar-nalli ondu oḷḷe flat bēku.
choices.en: Hello sir. Yes, I'm an engineer. I need a good flat in Indiranagar.
Yes sir, thank you for showing me.

beats.native: ಬನ್ನಿ ಮೇಲೆ. ಎರಡು bedroom, ಒಂದು hall, kitchen. ಮನೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕ — but ಗಾಳಿ ಬೆಳಕು ಸಾಕು.
beats.translit: banni mēle. eraḍu bedroom, ondu hall, kitchen. mane cikka — but gāḷi beḷaku sāku.
beats.en: Come up. Two bedrooms, one hall, kitchen. The house is small — but enough light and air.
beats.beat: climbing the stairs slowly, one hand on the railing

beats.native: Twenty-two thousand. ಆರು ತಿಂಗಳ advance. ಸಾಕು ತಾನೇ?
beats.translit: twenty-two thousand. āru tiṅgaḷa advance. sāku tānē?
beats.en: Twenty-two thousand. Six months advance. Is that enough?
beats.beat: doesn't haggle. just states it. waits.

choices.native: ಸಾರ್, ಆರು ತಿಂಗಳ advance ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ. ಮೂರು ತಿಂಗಳ ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾ?
choices.translit: sār, āru tiṅgaḷa advance svalpa jāsti. mūru tiṅgaḷa sādhyavā?
choices.en: Sir, six months advance is a bit much. Could we do three?
Let me think about it tonight.

beats.native: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಯೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ ಸಾರ್. ನೀವು ಒಬ್ಬರೇ ಇರ್ತೀರಾ?
beats.translit: svalpa yōcane māḍtīni sār. nīvu obbarē irtīrā?
beats.en: Let me think on it, sir. You'll be living alone?

choices.native: ಹೌದು ಸಾರ್. ಒಬ್ಬನೇ. Quiet ಆಗಿ ಇರ್ತೀನಿ, ಗಲಾಟೆ ಇಲ್ಲ.
choices.translit: haudu sār. obbanē. quiet āgi irtīni, galāṭe illa.
choices.en: Yes sir. Alone. I'll be quiet, no noise.
Yes, alone — though friends will visit sometimes.

beats.native: ಸರಿ ಸಾರ್. ನಾಳೆ ಮಾತಾಡೋಣ. Rangaswamy ಗೆ ಹೇಳಿ ನೀವು serious ಅಂತ.
beats.translit: sari sār. nāḷe mātāḍōṇa. Rangaswamy-ge hēḷi nīvu serious anta.
beats.en: Okay sir. We'll talk tomorrow. Tell Rangaswamy you're serious.
beats.beat: shakes your hand with both of his — old-school
